_comment: DJ Flo Rakete - Realtime Database rules.
Replace DJ_UID_HERE (2 places) with the DJ's Google account UID.
How to find it: open admin.html, sign in with Google once (it will say
'not the DJ account' - that is expected), then Firebase Console >
Authentication > Users > copy the UID of that Google row.
Guests sign in anonymously; the DJ signs in with Google. A random Google
account gets PERMISSION_DENIED, which is exactly what locks the panel.

$reqId..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && auth.token.firebase.sign_in_provider === 'anonymous' && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid) || auth.uid === 'DJ_UID_HERE')
